mfb: No set symbol is printed on these cards.
xya: Same yellow A symbol as Hidden Fates Shiny Vault, but here it's on the RIGHT of the card.
sma: Yellow A symbol on the LEFT of the card. Yellow A Alternate cards have the same symbol on the right.
rc: No set symbol of its own: the number starts with RC (RC1/RC25 to RC25/RC25).
exu: The number is a letter or sign instead of a number: A/28 to Z/28, then !/28 and ?/28.
pkw26: Pikachu pumpkin stamp plus the Play! Pokémon logo.
Only 3 cards: Zubat 049/086, Golbat 050/086 and Crobat 051/086 (Chaos Rising), silver border, reverse holo.
Given out at Play! Pokémon League events, October 2026.
pkw25: Pikachu pumpkin stamp plus the Play! Pokémon logo.
Only 1 card: Spiritomb 087/132 (Mega Evolution), silver border, reverse holo.
Given out at Play! Pokémon League events, October 2025.
tot24: Pikachu pumpkin stamp only (no Play! Pokémon logo). Silver border.
Set codes are later Scarlet & Violet ones: OBF, MEW, PAR, PAF, TEF or TWM.
The 10 holos are Cosmos holo (swirling bubbles over the art and the border).
Came in orange BOOster bundles with Umbreon art.
tot23: Pikachu pumpkin stamp only. Silver border.
Set symbol is a Sword & Shield one, or the set code is SVI or PAL.
The 10 holos are mirror/line holo, not Cosmos.
tot22: Pikachu pumpkin stamp only. Yellow border: the only Trick or Trade year with yellow borders.
Every card has a Sword & Shield set symbol.
Came in orange BOOster bundles with Gengar art.
miscp: One card: Ancient Mew, given out with Pokémon: The Movie 2000.
